question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Consensus is ~$12.9B and UBS is at $13.8B (AI $7.6B, connectivity $4.9B, space $1.3B). Q3 is the first full quarter of Anthropic's $1.25B/month compute payments ($3.75B). Google's $920M/month deal ramped at a reduced fee through September, and Cursor (closed Aug 14) adds about six weeks of revenue. Starlink is growing ~50-60% YoY from $4.29B in Q2. SpaceX beat Q2 consensus by ~$1B, so the median sits slightly above consensus. The downside is uncertainty over Google ramp revenue and falling Starlink ARPU. The report is scheduled for Oct 20, before resolution. No human prediction market on revenue was found (Polymarket only lists share-price contracts).
